text:
Maya: Fog's brutal this morning, ferry app shows delays + packed boats. Anyone swapping to BART?
Ethan: Im on the 7:10 ferry and it's crawling. Might jump off at Embarcadero and try Muni.
Priya: Heads upEmbarcadero platform slippery. I slipped twice, shoes saved by coffee-to-go lid. :coffee:
Leo: Pro-tip: keep a thin packable towel in your bag. Also, who wants my extra umbrella? Lost the handle but it still blocks rain.
Maya: @Leo I will absolutely take that Frankenstein umbrella. Meet in lobby in 5.
transit-bot: [notice] SF Ferry: vessel departures delayed up to 20m due to fog and reduced visibility. Expect crowding. BART normal, minor boarding delays at Embarcadero.
Ethan: If ferry's delayed >15m I'm calling it WFH. Can't focus with soggy socks.
Priya: Poll: umbrella or poncho? reply with "U" or "P"
Leo: U
Maya: U
Ethan: P -> hands-free, keeps my laptop dry.
Priya: Decision: umbrella stash in lobby this week and a tiny rack for towels. Facilities ok with trial.
Maya: Also shoutout to the commuter who handed out extra coffee sleeves to dry the phone. Legend. :clap:
Ethan: GIF incoming of a tiny rubber duck floating on a puddle.
